$comment: Single source of truth for how CrimeMap SA groups the source offence variables.
Consumed by BOTH the Python pipeline (scripts/) and the TypeScript app (src/lib/crime/).
Every 'name' below is a real column in the source dataset - see source_schema.json.
The grouping follows the South African Police Service's own published structure:
17 community-reported serious crimes in four groups (contact, contact-related,
property-related, other serious), plus crimes detected as a result of police action.
Reference: SAPS crime statistics releases, e.g.
IMPORTANT: some source columns are TOTALS that already contain other columns.
'aggr_robbery' contains its six subcategories and 'sexual_offences' contains its four.
Summing every column would double count. Only role='headline' rows enter group totals.

roles.headline: One of the 17 community-reported serious crimes or the 4 police-detected crimes. Enters group totals.
roles.subcategory: A published breakdown of a headline category. Already included in its parent. Never added to totals.
roles.standalone: Present in the source but not part of the 17 or the 4. Reported on its own, never added to totals.

contact.label: Contact crime
contact.description: Crimes in which the victim is the target of violence or the threat of violence.

contact_related.label: Contact-related crime
contact_related.description: Violent crimes committed against property with intent to damage or destroy it.

property_related.label: Property-related crime
property_related.description: Crimes targeting property where the victim is not present.

other_serious.label: Other serious crime
other_serious.description: All theft not mentioned elsewhere, commercial crime and shoplifting.

police_action.label: Crime detected as a result of police action
police_action.description: Crime typically recorded after police deployment or intelligence rather than public reporting.

unclassified.label: Other recorded crime
unclassified.description: Recorded in the source dataset but not part of the 17 community-reported serious crimes or the 4 crimes detected as a result of police action.

categories.name: sexual_offences
categories.label: Sexual offences
categories.note: SAPS publishes 'Sexual offences' as one of the 17 community-reported serious crimes, broken down into rape, sexual assault, attempted sexual offences and contact sexual offences. VERIFIED AGAINST v1.4 (24,206 rows): this column equals the sum of those four breakdown columns in 2023/24 onwards (3,517 of 3,518 rows) but not before, where it is consistently smaller than that sum and matches no stable subset. It is also entirely absent for 2005/06 to 2007/08. CrimeMap SA therefore uses this column as the sexual offences figure and never sums the breakdown columns into a total, so the breakdown's inconsistency in earlier years cannot distort any total.

categories.name: assault_gbh
categories.label: Assault with intent to inflict grievous bodily harm

categories.name: aggr_robbery
categories.label: Robbery with aggravating circumstances
categories.note: Contains the six subcategories below, but is larger than their sum because SAPS publishes them as only SOME subcategories of aggravated robbery: street robbery and other aggravated robberies are inside this total without a separate column. VERIFIED AGAINST v1.4: this column is greater than or equal to the sum of the six in 24,196 of 24,206 rows. The pipeline therefore tests containment rather than equality, and the ten rows that breach it are reported.

categories.name: vehicle_theft
categories.label: Theft of motor vehicle and motorcycle

categories.name: theft_from_vehicle
categories.label: Theft out of or from motor vehicle
categories.source_label: Theft out of or from motor vehicle

categories.name: other_theft
categories.label: All theft not mentioned elsewhere
categories.source_label: Other theft not including vehicle and stock theft

categories.name: illegal_firearms
categories.label: Illegal possession of firearms and ammunition
categories.source_label: Illegal possession of firearms and ammunition

categories.name: dui
categories.label: Driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs

categories.name: police_detected_sexoff
categories.label: Sexual offences detected as a result of police action

categories.name: kidnapping
categories.label: Kidnapping
categories.note: Present in the source dataset but not one of the 17 community-reported serious crimes or the 4 crimes detected as a result of police action. Reported on its own and excluded from every total.

contact_crime_total.label: Contact crime
contact_crime_total.definition: Sum of the headline contact crime categories: murder, attempted murder, sexual offences, assault with intent to inflict grievous bodily harm, common assault, common robbery and robbery with aggravating circumstances. Subcategories are excluded because they are already contained in their parent.

contact_related_total.label: Contact-related crime
contact_related_total.definition: Sum of arson and malicious damage to property.

property_crime_total.label: Property-related crime
property_crime_total.definition: Sum of burglary at residential premises, burglary at non-residential premises, theft of motor vehicle and motorcycle, theft out of or from motor vehicle and stock-theft.

other_serious_total.label: Other serious crime
other_serious_total.definition: Sum of all theft not mentioned elsewhere, commercial crime and shoplifting.

police_action_total.label: Crime detected as a result of police action
police_action_total.definition: Sum of illegal possession of firearms and ammunition, drug-related crime, driving under the influence of alcohol or drugs, and sexual offences detected as a result of police action.

total_recorded_crime.label: Recorded crime (17 community-reported serious crimes)
total_recorded_crime.definition: Sum of contact crime, contact-related crime, property-related crime and other serious crime. This matches the SAPS headline '17 community reported serious crime' aggregate. It excludes crimes detected as a result of police action and excludes kidnapping.

total_including_police_action.label: Recorded crime including crimes detected by police action
total_including_police_action.definition: total_recorded_crime plus police_action_total. Reported separately because crimes detected as a result of police action reflect police activity rather than public reporting, so mixing them into a single headline figure would be misleading.

featured_series.$comment: Category options offered in the trend chart. Composite options are CrimeMap SA groupings and are labelled as such in the UI.

robbery.label: Robbery
robbery.definition: CrimeMap SA grouping: robbery with aggravating circumstances plus common robbery.

burglary.label: Burglary
burglary.definition: CrimeMap SA grouping: burglary at residential premises plus burglary at non-residential premises.

vehicle_theft.label: Vehicle theft
vehicle_theft.definition: The source theft of motor vehicle and motorcycle column.

assault.label: Assault
assault.definition: CrimeMap SA grouping: assault with intent to inflict grievous bodily harm plus common assault.

consistency_checks.description: Robbery with aggravating circumstances must be at least the sum of the six published subcategories, because those are only some of its subcategories. A total smaller than the sum of its own parts cannot be correct and is reported. Neither value is altered.

From 2023/24 the source's sexual offences column equals the sum of its four breakdown columns, so a mismatch from that year onwards is reported. Earlier years are excluded from this check because the source itself does not maintain that relationship; that inconsistency is described on the methodology page rather than corrected.
